Breaking news? Check. Sports? Check. How-tos? Check. The occasional video about cute puppies? Check. 

PennLive is all about keeping you in the loop about all things Pennsylvania. So whether you live in York, Lancaster, Carlisle, Philadelphia or Pittsburgh, there's a little something here for you.
